We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starshield's global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help us further our ambitious goals. We are looking for a senior engineer to develop and continually test the cyber defenses of the Starshield network. This job will be hands-on and require breadth of experience in both software and security. A great candidate for this role appreciates a challenge, thrives on curiosity, and wants to make a difference in the world. ELECTRICAL ENGINEER, HARDWARE RELIABILITY (STARLINK) At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. As a Sr. Electrical Engineer on the Starlink team, you will be responsible for electrical hardware failure analysis, PCBA reliability, and quality of the PCBA production process. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role and engineers on this team are responsible for solving systemic production issues, running root cause of failures from end to end, and working to drive process changes for continually improving product quality. Engineers in this role are expected to become intimately familiar with the circuits, manufacturing processes, and test procedures for the designs they support. jobs.title: Sr. Electrical Hardware Engineer, AI Satellites (Starmind)
jobs.description_text: SR. ELECTRICAL HARDWARE ENGINEER, AI SATELLITES (STARMIND) SpaceX is leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. Realizing this vision demands highly reliable, high performance electrical hardware ranging from power electronics, high speed digital systems, mixed signal designs, robust avionics, networking, and custom compute electronics. These systems must operate in the extreme environment of space while delivering the connectivity, control, power distribution, and processing needed for orbital AI inference. The Starmind team designs, builds, and operates the orbital compute fabric of the future. We develop nearly every key piece of technology in house – from the satellites’ flight computers and power systems to the fully custom compute electronics, memory, and networking that form the brain of our on-orbit data centers. As a Senior Electrical Design Engineer on the Starmind Payload Engineering team, you’ll have ownership over the entire life-cycle of the hardware that enables advanced on-orbit AI processing and data center workloads. Your work sits at the intersection of electrical, mechanical, thermal, and software engineering. jobs.description_text: SR. ELECTROMAGNETIC EFFECTS ENGINEER (LIGHTNING EFFECTS) As a member of our fast-paced electromagnetic environmental effects (E3) team, you will be responsible for ensuring hardware performance through some of the harshest and varied electromagnetic environments imaginable. Your explicit goal will be ensuring that our orbital class reusable launch vehicles are designed to handle direct and indirect effects of lightning phenomena. The E3 team at SpaceX performs exhaustive analysis, design, and test at the board, unit, subsystem, and system levels with extensive opportunity to interact with a vast array of rocket, spacecraft, and ground support equipment hardware and electronics. jobs.title: Sr. Fluids Systems Engineer, Production (Starship)
jobs.description_text: SR. FLUIDS ENGINEER, PRODUCTION (STARSHIP) Starship is the largest and most capable space launch system ever developed. With the capability to deliver in excess of 100 metric tons to Earth’s orbit, it will fundamentally change access to space, and is the technology that will be used to establish a self-sustaining city on Mars. We will ultimately need thousands of Starships to accomplish that feat. The Starbase production fluids team builds, maintains, and operates the fluid systems the Starship factory runs on. This includes high pressure production test equipment used to validate vehicles and components, vehicle press systems, and cleaning and contamination control equipment. Engineers on this team own hardware from problem statement through design, build, commissioning, and handoff to the technicians and operators who use it every day. We are looking for hands-on engineers who can reduce a messy production problem to first principles, design the simplest system that meets the requirement, and stay with it until it is fully handed off and documented. You will work directly with our build shop, partner teams, and production customers on an accelerated schedule. RESPONSIBILITIES: Design, build, and commission fluid systems for Starship production, including test systems, manufacturing systems, and cleaning equipment. jobs.description_text: SR. GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER (FALCON/DRAGON/STARFALL) Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, and Dragon fly at a cadence the rest of the industry still treats as a goal. That only works if the right hardware is on the floor, at the right cost, from a supply base that can actually scale. SpaceX is looking for a Global Supply Manager to own a Falcon / Dragon commodity book end to end — strategy, source selection, contracts, coverage, cost, and continuity of supply. You will run a live production supply base and partner with engineering, supplier development, planning, production, quality, finance, and legal. jobs.title: Structural Engineer, Starship Tower
jobs.description_text: STRUCTURAL ENGINEER, STARSHIP TOWER The Starship catch tower will redefine ground support systems for launch vehicles as we know them, with the ultimate goal of launching, catching, and relaunching orbital boosters in hours or days instead of weeks or months. The tower the largest steel structure ever built to support a launch vehicle. It must survive the acoustic, thermal, and blast environment of the most powerful rocket in the world at liftoff, absorb the loads of catching a returning booster, and then be ready to do it again within days. As the Structural Engineer on the Tower team, you will own the structural integrity of these structures from concept through fabrication, erection, activation, and launch operations. You will perform and own the structural design and analysis of primary and secondary steel, connections, anchorage, and foundation interfaces; develop and issue drawings, calculations, and specifications; and lead consulting engineers, fabricators, and construction contractors through engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, and commissioning. You will work hand in hand with the mechanical, mechanisms, fluids, and analysis engineers on the team to ensure the structure meets requirements for both the design and the manufacturing and integration processes. jobs.description_text: About the Role We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Buyer to join our growing procurement team. This role is critical in supporting the transition of components and printed circuit boards (PCBs) from development into full-scale production for aerospace applications. You’ll work closely with engineering, quality, planning, and supply chain teams to ensure supplier readiness, cost efficiency, and compliance with industry standards. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position in question, which is based on market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on location, skills and expertise, depth of relevant experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply for the role and are selected for an interview.

jobs.title: Core Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are hiring a Core Software Engineer to deliver reliable 5G Core network functions and control-plane services that support next-generation mobile and satellite networks. You will architect, develop, and maintain critical network functions and control-plane services that form the backbone of next-generation mobile telecommunications infrastructure. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who takes responsibility for results, makes timely decisions, and stays engaged until the solution works. You will apply your knowledge of 3GPP protocols, distributed systems, and service-oriented architecture to advance our 5G Core processing solutions and turn technical commitments into working software.

jobs.title: Director, Payload Electronics, Space Communications Systems
jobs.description_text: Your Mission Deliver payload electronics the program can count on, working for its users in space on a record schedule. Turn a signal-chain architecture with noise, linearity, timing and power budgets, a sequenced plan, accountable owners and hardware that passes test. Velocity of decision making is paramount: you close architecture trades in days, not quarters, and you build that pace into every engineer on the team.

jobs.title: Electrical Test Engineer, EGSE & Instrumentation
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a hands-on Electrical Test Engineer to own electrical verification and electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) for E-Space’s integrated antenna assembly. You will build and troubleshoot electrical test setups, solder test hardware, write test software (Labview, Python), configure and run data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and operate spacecraft and instrument surrogates for verification testing. This is an electrical engineering role with substantial bench and test facility work. You will own the electrical test chain from the hardware connection through acquisition, automation, and recorded evidence. During environmental campaigns, you will work alongside the engineer responsible for mechanical testing, providing electrical test support and functional verification. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Hands-on bench work and test facility presence are required. Some travel between sites expected.

jobs.title: Facilities Security Officer
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE: We’re seeking an experienced Facilities Security Officer (FSO) who can lead, design, and execute a comprehensive industrial security program for a classified “possessing” facility. This role will also serve as the Insider Threat Program Senior Official (ITPSO), responsible for developing and maintaining a proactive insider threat and awareness program. You’ll be joining E-Space at a pivotal moment — helping establish our cleared operations from the ground up and ensuring compliance with the National Industrial Security Program (NISP), DoD 5220.22-M (NISPOM), and related directives.

jobs.title: Internal Communications Manager
jobs.description_text: We are hiring an Internal Communications Manager to build the systems, channels, and culture programs that keep E-Space informed and connected as we grow from about 350 to 1,000+ employees over the next 18 months. You will take what exists and build the infrastructure that makes E-Space feel like one coherent company, where people understand the mission, see how their work connects to it, and want to show up. This is a builder role. You will balance two equally important missions: owning the systems that keep the company aligned, and partnering with the People team on the culture programs, celebrations, and spaces that make work feel meaningful. You will work in an environment with competing asks, real ambiguity, and high expectations, and you will need to make calls about what gets done, in what order, and what does not, without waiting for permission. This role is internally facing. E-Space is in Stealth Mode while we build our technology, so the role does not include external communications or PR. It reports to the Head of People and operates as a shared service between the executive leadership team and the broader company.

jobs.title: Junior Facilities Maintenance Technician
jobs.description_text: Reports to: Facilities & Maintenance Supervisor We are hiring a Junior Facilities Maintenance Technician to help keep our buildings, equipment, and work areas safe, reliable, and ready for manufacturing and daily operations. You will support general repairs, preventive maintenance, and facility projects while learning from experienced technicians. This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership of assigned work, responds with urgency, and follows through until the result is verified. You will work under experienced technicians and Facilities leadership, recognize the limits of your training, and ask for guidance before proceeding beyond your authorization.

jobs.title: Senior Antenna Design Engineer - Satellite User Terminals
jobs.description_text: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer, PLC/Beckhoff
jobs.description_text: The E-Space Manufacturing team builds the world's most advanced aerospace products at high rate and high precision. As a Senior Controls Engineer, you'll architect, program, and deploy the Beckhoff-based control systems that run our robotic and precision-assembly lines. You'll be the dedicated controls owner the team needs - relieving today's reliance on a handful of people - and combine strong software design with hands-on hardware integration to deliver world-class reliability and throughput. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - HPC and EDA Infrastructure
jobs.description_text: This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Santa Clara, CA location. The target base pay for this position in Santa Clara, California is $140,000 - $200,000 annually. The total compensation package will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience and location. We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used—so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience – then we’ll be immediately wow-ed. E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Systems Designer
jobs.description_text: The E-Space Manufacturing team builds the world's most advanced aerospace products at high rate and high precision. As a Senior Mechanical Systems Designer, you'll design the mechanical systems that make E-Space's automated production lines run - fixtures, frames, motion assemblies, and the hardware that ties automation together. You'll work hands-on in SolidWorks alongside a Staff designer and the broader manufacturing team, owning subsystems end-to-end and bringing them from concept to qualified production hardware. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

jobs.title: Senior Patent Agent
jobs.description_text: About the Role E-Space designs and manufactures low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites for 5G communications, associated ground-based Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and radar systems for space-based and ground-based applications. We are seeking a Senior Patent Agent to take substantial ownership of patent preparation and prosecution across these technologies. Working directly with Lead IP Counsel and engineering teams, you will turn complex inventions into high-quality patent applications and pursue commercially meaningful claim coverage. This is a hands-on role: approximately 60% of your time will involve drafting applications, with approximately 30–40% devoted to prosecution. You will personally draft most assigned applications and all U.S. Office Action responses for assigned matters, and review outside counsel’s non-U.S. Office Action responses. The role calls for an experienced practitioner who can produce high-quality work with limited supervision and is proficient using AI-based tools effectively.

jobs.title: Senior RF Front-End Design Engineer - Satellite User Terminals
jobs.description_text: E-Space is seeking a Senior RF Front-End Design Engineer to develop transmit and receive electronics for satellite communication user terminals. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who can translate system and link requirements into robust RF hardware and take designs from architecture through device-level circuit design, PCB implementation, prototype bring-up, validation, and production release. The successful candidate will work closely with antenna, modem, baseband, firmware, power, mechanical, thermal, test, and manufacturing teams to deliver efficient and reliable user-terminal RF hardware. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Occasional travel may be required. This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Arlington, TX facility. The target base pay for this position is $160,000 - $195,000 annually. The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used—so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience – then we’ll be immediately wow-ed. E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
jobs.description_text: The E-Space Manufacturing team builds the world's most advanced aerospace products at high rate and high precision. As a Senior Robotics Engineer, you'll program and integrate the ABB and Fanuc robots that assemble our satellites. You'll own robotic cells end-to-end - from path planning and EOAT integration to commissioning and cycle-time optimization - and serve as the dedicated robotics owner the team needs as we scale. This is a hands-on role for someone who has deployed industrial robots in production and wants to build a robotics function from a strong foundation. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

jobs.title: Senior Scheduler
jobs.description_text: We are scaling a portfolio of U.S. Government programs, and are hiring the person who will own how this company plans and schedules that work. This is not a role that inherits a scheduling function. You will define it. You will set the scheduling standard, build the toolchain and templates, establish the status and baseline control process, support Program Managers and technical leads to work within it, and then own the Integrated Master Schedule for the portfolio on an ongoing basis. We are looking for a career space program scheduler — someone who has built and defended an IMS on satellite, payload, or ground systems development programs. You will have direct authority over scheduling methodology across Government Programs.

jobs.title: Buyer / Supply Chain & Logistics Spring Intern (Austin)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Buyer / Supply Chain & Logistics Intern to join our Supply Chain & Manufacturing team in Austin for the Spring 2027 term, January 12 to April 16, 2027. Every P3 module is built from thousands of parts: steel, optics, insulation, valves, motors and power electronics, sourced from suppliers across the U.S. and around the world. You'll help get the right parts to our factory floor on time and at the right cost. This is a hands-on internship. You'll place real purchase orders, work directly with suppliers and freight carriers, and see the parts you buy become hardware that ships to customer sites.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager (Austin, TX)
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a hands-on Global Supply Manager with exceptional negotiation skills to establish and manage commercial relationships with contract manufacturers and strategic partners. In this role, you will own cost negotiations, supply planning, and risk management while driving cost reduction through operational efficiency and disciplined processes. You will be instrumental in executing projects that meet both product milestones and corporate goals. This role sits at the intersection of internal engineering teams and external manufacturing partners, requiring someone who can balance competing priorities to ensure successful product launches. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-moving environment, drives excellence across their own responsibilities and those of team members and partners, and communicates concisely and effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional peers alike. This employee will be based in Austin, TX, and will also work from our Miami headquarters as needed. Relocation to Austin, TX is required, and relocation assistance will be provided.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager MBA Spring Intern (Austin)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Global Supply Manager MBA Intern to join our Supply Chain & Manufacturing team in Austin for the Spring 2027 term, January 12 to April 16, 2027. You'll work alongside our Global Supply Managers on the commercial side of building P3: choosing contract manufacturers and suppliers, negotiating cost, planning supply and managing risk as we move from first units toward volume production. This is a strategic internship with real stakes. You'll own a sourcing project from analysis to recommendation, sit in on supplier negotiations, and present your findings to Supply Chain & Manufacturing leadership.

jobs.title: Supply Chain & Manufacturing Spring Intern - Manufacturing (Austin)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Supply Chain & Manufacturing Intern – Manufacturing to join our team in Austin for the Spring 2027 term, January 12 to April 16, 2027. You'll work directly with our Supply Chain & Manufacturing team on the processes that bring P3 modules to life. Your work will span the factory floor and the supply base: developing how P3 modules are assembled, and helping negotiate with the suppliers who keep materials flowing. You'll see end to end how a hardware company scales from early units to volume production.

jobs.title: Research Scientist Intern, AI Molecular Design (Winter/Spring)
jobs.description_text: GenBio AI is an AI for Science company on a mission to make biology fully computable. We are building AIDO (AI-Driven Digital Organism) to simulate living systems, decode biology holistically, and accelerate medical and scientific research. Our first step toward that mission is AIDO Cell, the first virtual cell world model that holistically simulates cell biology from molecules up to whole-cell behavior. It enables researchers to run experiments virtually, predicting how cells respond to genetic changes, drugs and other interventions before going into the lab. It is supported by AIDO Foundry, an AI-builds-AI engineering framework for automating virtual cell development, and AIDO Lab, an interface to digitally run experiments and observe the results. Together they form the foundation for a new paradigm in AI-driven drug discovery, bioengineering, and fundamental biomedical research.

This role will focus primarily on the embedded flight software and networking that enable communication between our aircraft and ground control systems. You will develop software supporting command and control, telemetry, network management, RF communications, and vehicle data links while working closely with avionics, RF, flight software, and ground systems engineers. This is not a traditional voice communications role. You will work on the software and network infrastructure that allow an air vehicle and ground control station to reliably exchange commands, telemetry, and other mission-critical data. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between embedded C/C++ development, network and communications system design, and hands-on testing with target hardware. You will have ownership across both the vehicle and ground sides of the communications network and will help take systems from initial architecture through integration and flight operations.

jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Maga

jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.description_text: At Neighbor, our vision is to bring communities together by solving our neighbors’ biggest challenges. We’re building the largest hyper-local marketplace the world has seen. jobs.title: FP&A Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: About the Role As our FP&A Intern, you’ll work on the numbers leadership uses to run the company. You’ll help build the annual plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range models, and you’ll present your work to our senior leadership team. You’ll report to the FP&A Manager and work on the real plan, the real forecasts, and the materials that go in front of our board. Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace, which makes the finance work here unusually interesting. You’ll dig into how supply and demand grow market by market, what drives our take rate, and what it costs to acquire a host or a renter. By the end of the summer, you’ll own expense forecasting for the entire business. This internship is a direct path to a full-time role. Strong performers leave with a full-time offer to join the team after graduation.

jobs.title: Marketplace Growth Associate
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Marketplace Growth Associate, you’ll work with Neighbor’s hosts: the commercial and residential property owners who list their storage and parking space on our marketplace. Hosts are the supply side of everything we do. The more easily renters can find a host’s space, the more that host earns and the faster the marketplace grows in every city we serve. You’ll be one of the people making that happen, one host at a time. Most of your day (50–75%) is outbound phone calls with hosts. On each call, you’ll help a host make their listing stronger and easier to find: setting up a Google Maps pin, tightening photos and descriptions, getting the price right, and building up reviews. The goal is to turn their space into steady, growing income. The rest of your time is operations: running the signage program, tracking results and finding ways to make the whole thing work better. This role fits you if you like being on the phone, you can manage a high volume of work on your own, and you tend to notice when a process could run better.

jobs.title: UX Designer (Junior, Mid and Senior Level Opportunities Available)
jobs.description_text: About the Role Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace for self storage and vehicle storage. Hosts list everything from garages and driveways to RV pads and commercial facility units, and renters compare options, book, and manage reservations through Neighbor’s website and apps. You’ll report directly to a Co-Founder and our VP of Product & Design, and you’ll set the bar for design craft across the company. That means mentoring Neighbor’s other designers, shaping product direction with PMs and engineers from the first sketch, and making sure real renter insight reaches every team. Renters on Neighbor compare everything from storage facility units to neighborhood garages and RV pads. Helping them choose with confidence is a hard design problem, and solving it moves the business directly. This role is based in our Lehi, Utah office, in person Tuesday through Friday, with the option to work from home on Mondays.

The Payload Lead is the leader of the multidisciplinary technical team, the primary point of contact for the program manager, and often a key interface point for our customers. Success in this role requires deep expertise in technical topics as well as project management, leadership, and communication in a fast-paced startup environment.

We are looking for candidates with a strong foundation in digital design or software-based verification concepts and an interest in applying those skills to FPGA development. Designs encompass the entire spectrum of power supply development including power conversion, power management and control, fault management, and power filtering for low noise and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC). We’re looking for summer interns to support our mission. Interns work side-by-side with experienced power electronics engineers. Interns in the Analog & Power team are typically responsible for design projects that directly contribute towards an on-going program or contribute towards advancing the Analog & Power Electronics team’s technology development road map. Interns will also gain valuable experience in hands-on laboratory characterization and troubleshooting of power electronics. To apply, please include a brief cover letter describing your interest in power or analog electronics hardware design.

jobs.title: Supervisor Quality Control
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Supervisor, Quality Control to our team. In this role you will monitor daily inspection and quality control activities to ensure hardware meets engineering specifications, customer requirements, and established aerospace quality standards. This role assigns inspection work, coordinates personnel and resources, monitors productivity, and reviews inspection results and documentation for accuracy and completeness. The Supervisor addresses routine product quality concerns, maintains established inspection procedures, and supports consistent product acceptance and manufacturing operations. This position requires an experienced quality control professional with practical knowledge of inspection methods, product acceptance, nonconformance control, and quality management systems. Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, and Quality Assurance, the Supervisor coordinates inspection priorities, communicates quality concerns, and supports resolution of issues affecting daily workflow, production schedules, and product conformity.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Talent Acquisition Partner to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about hiring top talent to work on satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for building a pipeline of candidates to help develop leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems. You will collaborate with hiring managers and key stakeholders to identify, attract, and hire top talent in various disciplines within the aerospace industry. This is a multifaceted job that requires strong technical aptitude and the ability to effectively assess the technical capabilities of candidates, along with outstanding organizational skills and the ability to understand and promote the value proposition Cesium offers. Talent acquisition activities will include sourcing candidates from a variety of platforms and helping to develop high-impact recruiting strategies. You will work closely with Cesium engineering and business staff to develop and execute talent acquisition projects.

jobs.title: Test Technician III
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add an Test Technician III to our team. If you are excited about working in a startup environment, have a strong work ethic, and are passionate about cutting-edge electronics, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will work closely with CesiumAstro engineers to create module & payload performance test setups, execute test plans, and produce timely, reliable test results. You will have the opportunity to use and maintain state-of-the-art electronics lab instrumentation, such as spectrum analyzers, VNAs, automated power supplies, and more. You will be challenged to propose and fabricate intricate test setups to increase productivity and improve test results. Many of our products include active phased arrays (a.k.a. active electronically scanned arrays, or AESAs). These are antenna products with active RF circuitry integrated with the antenna. This adds complexity to the test architecture, including power, digital control, and thermal effects. As such, direct experience with phased array (or AESA) testing is preferred. Core day-to-day activities will include aligning with engineers to test and troubleshoot complex electronics and RF circuitry from component level to system level. As such, the ability to understand and work from drawings, diagrams, schematics, and test procedures is key. jobs.title: Trade Compliance Administrator II
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Trade Compliance Administrator II to our team. In this role you will perform trade compliance activities involving export licensing, regulatory classifications, technology transfers, and compliance documentation across aerospace and defense products and business operations. This role applies established trade compliance procedures to review export transactions, assess routine authorization requirements, conduct regulatory screening, and maintain accurate compliance records. Through execution of assigned activities, the Trade Compliance Administrator II supports regulatory compliance, accurate documentation, and effective management of export-controlled transactions. Working cross-functionally with Engineering, Supply Chain, Contracts, Legal, Manufacturing, Program Management, Human Resources, and Security, this role supports export authorization activities, regulatory compliance reviews, documentation requirements, and routine issue resolution that contribute to compliant business operations.

jobs.title: Vice President of Business Development (Commercial)
jobs.location_raw: Westminster, CO · El Segundo, CA · Austin, TX
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Vice President of Business Development (Commercial) to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment, and have a mind for the business of technology, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for marketing, sales, and developing business opportunities and relationships with potential CesiumAstro customers. The area of responsibility for this role is broad and requires a wide range of knowledge about the space industry, telecommunication and RF electronic products, technology commercialization, market analysis, relationship management, and strategic planning. Daily responsibilities include developing and continuously updating the commercial and DOD aerospace telecommunication electronics market potential and trends, identifying opportunities, writing and submitting RFI and RFP responses, visiting existing and potential customers, interfacing with engineering and product development staff to articulate market gaps and demands, assisting in the strategic and R&D roadmaps for the company, and ultimately leading the top line revenue growth for the company. The successful candidate will be highly experienced in aerospace electronics sales and marketing, particularly RF and telecommunications equipment. The ideal candidate is extremely organized, articulate, flexible, quick to grasp business needs, a team player, an excellent written and oral communicator, and eager to learn.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Facilities
jobs.description_text: The Vice President, Global Facilities is responsible for the strategic leadership and management of CesiumAstro’s global facilities and real estate portfolio. In this role you will oversee the full lifecycle of company sites, from site identification and acquisition through lease negotiation, buildout, occupancy, maintenance, expansion, relocation, and disposition. This position will develop and execute a global facilities and real estate strategy aligned with CesiumAstro’s growth, manufacturing, engineering, R&D, customer, and operational requirements. This includes oversight of company-owned and leased properties, real estate transactions, leases and contracts, property maintenance, capital projects, site selection, and long-range footprint planning. The Vice President, Global Facilities serves as the senior facilities and real estate advisor to executive leadership and partners closely with Finance, Legal, HR, EHS, Security, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations to ensure CesiumAstro has the right facilities, infrastructure, and capacity to support current and future growth.

jobs.title: Wire Harness Design Engineer II
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Wire Harness Design Engineer II to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge hardware for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. This role focuses on designing the critical power, digital, analog, and RF interconnects that turn boxes into systems. You will have the opportunity to take full ownership of wire harness designs, including schematic development, cable routing, connector selection, and harness assembly drawings. The environment is highly collaborative, working shoulder-to-shoulder with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, and harness assembly technicians to develop cutting-edge space and airborne systems. The role encompasses the full design process, from defining initial specifications through integration and test. You will also participate in design reviews, providing technical expertise and recommendations to enhance the performance and reliability of wire harness systems.

jobs.description_text: The Role The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP. jobs.title: Manager, Market Access
jobs.description_text: The Manager, Market Access will work collaboratively as part of the Vascular Marketing team. In this role, you will work closely with senior executives and cross-functionally with other departments to create value-proposition messaging for Penumbra products and therapies by providing health economic and reimbursement support for field team and beyond. This may include health economic studies, health economic data analysis, reimbursement analysis and strategy (coverage, coding, and payment). What You’ll Work On Support cross-functional teams on development of health economic, value messaging, reimbursement and coverage strategies based on robust understanding of physicians, business/practice managers, payers, and their decision-making systems. Manage key relationships with providers, payer, international reimbursement teams and sales force as appropriate. Support each customer group in a manner that reflects their needs and expectations of the business partnership and working with internal cross functional teams to communicate the Penumbra value proposition. Provide customer perspective on development of internal/external coding/coverage/reimbursement strategies, education, tools and support. Provide perspective on economic buyer and commercial payer-related issues related to reimbursement, coverage, and contracting for the Penumbra product portfolio.
